parent.title: Weekend at Slagmolen: lodging, activities and tech events around a Michelin watermill

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Slagmolen
siblings.summary: Book one of Slagmolen's four on-site villa rooms first; Bed and Beyond is the only true walking-distance fallback at 1.6 km.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Slagmolen
siblings.summary: Eight character stays around Slagmolen — from the four luxury rooms above the watermill to a 1736 chaplain's-residence inn, a designer B&B, a castle hotel and woodland cabins.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Slagmolen
siblings.summary: BSides Limburg (Mar), IEEE WCCI Maastricht (Jun), FTI Festival Hasselt-Genk (Oct-Nov), plus EnergyVille and Brightlands seminars filling the calendar.

sources.title: Hoge Kempen — Gateways
sources.claim: Nine official park gateways; seven within 30 km of Slagmolen.

sources.title: Mechelse Heide gateway
sources.claim: Seven hiking loops; 1.5 km wheelchair Zandloperpad; no visitors' lounge.

sources.title: Panorama Point Mechelse Heide
sources.claim: 104 m above sea level — highest in the park; on a clear day, views to Germany.

sources.title: Kattevennen — Getting here
sources.claim: 150-space car park, 2 EV chargers; year-round Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00.

sources.title: Kattevennen gateway
sources.claim: Stars and planets theme; six hiking loops; Cosmodrome planetarium.

sources.title: Station As gateway
sources.claim: 31 m André Dumont derrick replica; 1,300 m narrow-gauge train; forest golf.

sources.title: Lieteberg Blotevoetenpad
sources.claim: ~3 km barefoot path; wood, stones, grass, loam, water; 18 m watchtower.

sources.title: Lieteberg visitor centre
sources.claim: Free parking; sunrise-to-sunset; Butterfly Garden 1 May–30 Sep.

sources.title: Thor Park gateway
sources.claim: 10 hiking loops; 2 km Steenmannetjespad; Lichtsporen light-art trail.

sources.title: Pietersheim gateway
sources.claim: 12th-c. Waterburcht water castle on 76 ha former royal estate.

sources.title: Cycling Through the Heathland
sources.claim: 4 km route on 700 ha of heath; ~300 m panoramic wooden bridge.

sources.title: Terhills — Hoge Kempen
sources.claim: Main gateway; National Park Visitor Center; 3.6 km loop to the long terril panorama.

sources.title: Park grazing management
sources.claim: Norwegian Fjord, Konik, Angus and donkeys graze the park year-round.

sources.title: Hoge Kempen National Park
sources.claim: Purple heather window: mid-August through mid-September.

sources.title: ViaMichelin distances
sources.claim: Mechelse Heide ~5 km; Genk ~13 km; Maasmechelen 15.5 km; Hasselt ~26-30 km.

sources.title: Cycling Through Water
sources.claim: Node 91 in Bokrijk; >200 m through a pond; water at eye level on both sides.

sources.title: Fietsen door het Water
sources.claim: Opened April 2016; 200 m × 3 m bike path through De Wijers pond.

sources.title: Cycling Through the Trees
sources.claim: Pijnven node 272; 700 m double helix, 100 m diameter, 10 m high; opened June 2019.

sources.title: Bosland — Fietsen door de Bomen
sources.claim: Open sunrise to sunset; accessible to cyclists, walkers, wheelchairs.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Fietsen door de Heide
sources.claim: 294 m bridge; opened 4 July 2021; ~15,000 cyclists in first week.

sources.title: Fietsparadijs Limburg
sources.claim: Pickup points Bokrijk, As, Kattevennen, Hasselt, Houthalen-Helchteren, Lieteberg, Pietersheim.

sources.title: Fietsknooppunt — Water + Heide loop
sources.claim: Stitched loop covering both Water and Heide bridges in one day.

sources.title: Bosland — suggested loops
sources.claim: 34 km and 62 km loops from Pijnven parking via the helix.

sources.title: Bokrijk bike rental
sources.claim: Accessible 6.3 km loop from junction 243 to the Water span at node 91.

sources.title: Maasmechelen distance
sources.claim: Maasmechelen 15.5 km / ~18 minutes from Opglabbeek.

sources.title: Bokrijk — ticket prices
sources.claim: Adult €17; child €3; family €37.

sources.title: Bokrijk — opening hours
sources.claim: Daily 10:00–18:00 in season; Mondays during Flemish school holidays.

sources.title: C-mine Expedition
sources.claim: 1.5 km route through old air shaft to top of Belgium's highest shaft tower.

sources.title: C-mine — ticket prices
sources.claim: €10 adult, €6 child (6-18), €8 senior, family €26.

sources.title: Low Countries — C-mine Expedition
sources.claim: Authentic headframe is more than 60 m high; panoramic viewpoint.

sources.title: Nationaal Jenevermuseum — visit
sources.claim: Tue-Sun 10:00-17:00; €10 adult with a tasting drink included.

sources.title: Z33 — Hasselt
sources.claim: Francesca Torzo's diamond-brick wing on the old beguinage site (2020).

sources.title: Z33 — 2026 programme
sources.claim: Raphaela Vogel commission for the Torzo wing; Vanello, dao, Mascini solos.

sources.title: Modemuseum Hasselt
sources.claim: Tue-Sun 10:00-17:00; adult €10, senior €8, youth €6.

sources.title: Schatkamer Sint-Catharinakerk
sources.claim: Codex Eyckensis — oldest illuminated manuscript in Belgium; sensory display.

sources.title: Treasury Sint-Catharina
sources.claim: Combo ticket (church + RAM + Apothecary) €6 at Markt 45.

sources.title: Maaseik Markt
sources.claim: 1 ha Mosan market square; Van Eyck statue; 15th–18th c. facades.

sources.title: Eisden Tuinwijk
sources.claim: British-style 1910–1928 garden city for the Limburg-Maas colliery; 5 km trail.

sources.title: Slagmolen Opglabbeek
sources.claim: 1511 oil watermill on the Bosbeek; restored 1685; protected since 1995.

sources.title: Hasselt distance
sources.claim: Hasselt 26–30 km from Opglabbeek (~20–32 min).

sources.title: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt — tickets
sources.claim: 85-99 cm €15; ≥1 m from €24 dated (€32 undated); family pack €105.

sources.title: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt — hours
sources.claim: Open daily ~10:00-17:30 (seasonal).

sources.title: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt
sources.claim: Indoor Studio 100 park; 25+ attractions; ~26 km from Opglabbeek.

sources.title: Domein Kelchterhoef
sources.claim: Free; 20 ha lake; sandy beach, slides, pedalos; supervised swim July–August.

sources.title: Kelchterhoef — Beestige Multimovopad
sources.claim: 2.5 km obstacle trail with climbing, balance and water play.

sources.title: Lieteberg — tarieven
sources.claim: Daily 10:00-18:00, 16 Mar–2 Nov; €10 adult; €6 under 1.20 m; free under 3.

sources.title: Lieteberg (NL)
sources.claim: Insect knowledge centre Hoes der Insecten; kabouterpad.

sources.title: Saraland zwembad
sources.claim: Subtropical pool: weekday €11.70 adult, weekend €17; family 2+2 €59.40.

sources.title: Park Molenheide — Aquapolis
sources.claim: Indoor subtropical swim paradise open to day visitors and park guests.

sources.title: be-MINE Beringen
sources.claim: Avonturenberg climbing terril, museum, climbing hall, downhill MTB, Todi diving.

sources.title: Avonturenberg
sources.claim: Daily ½ h pre-sunrise to ½ h post-sunset; 60 m coal terril with poles and nets.

sources.title: Mijnmuseum — tariefs
sources.claim: Daily 10:00-17:00; €4.50 kids 6-18; free under 6; +€4 Ondergrondsimulatie.

sources.title: Bokrijk — 2026 prices
sources.claim: Adult €17; child 3-12 €3; family subscription €95; season 4 Apr–8 Nov 2026.

sources.title: Cosmodrome — ticket info
sources.claim: Adults €12; kids 4-12 €10; free under 4.

sources.title: Karting Genk — kids
sources.claim: Kids from 1.25 m drive rental karts on the fun circuit.

sources.title: Duinengordel
sources.claim: ~3,000 ha nature area in Oudsbergen; 82 km of marked trails; free.

sources.title: Oudsbergen — Duinengordel
sources.claim: Speeltuinstraat access; 12 ha Joekelbos play forest; stroller-accessible.

sources.title: Lommelse Sahara
sources.claim: 200 ha dune + lake landscape; three colour routes; 30 m observation tower.

sources.title: Opglabbeek–Lommel distance
sources.claim: Road distance ~44 km — beyond the 30 km radius.

sources.title: Maasmechelen Village — hours
sources.claim: Open every day including Sundays 10:00-19:00 except 25 Dec & 1 Jan.

sources.title: Maasmechelen Village — brands
sources.claim: >100 designer brand boutiques with up to 60% off.

sources.title: Maasmechelen Village — FAQ
sources.claim: 1,600+ complimentary parking spaces; Sunday & holiday opening.

sources.title: About jenever
sources.claim: Hasselt has been the centre of the Belgian jenever industry since the 17th century.

sources.title: Jeneverfeesten Hasselt
sources.claim: 17–18 October 2026; Borrelmanneke fountain dispenses jenever instead of water.

sources.title: Wijndomein Aldeneyck
sources.claim: 10 ha of vineyards on the south-east-facing Meuse slopes in Maaseik.

sources.title: Aldeneyck — tastings
sources.claim: Open tastings Friday & Saturday 10:00-18:00; reservation recommended.

sources.title: Vineyard Aldeneyck
sources.claim: Repeatedly Best Belgian Wine; Gault-Millau 2023 for Riesling 2019 & Pinot Noir 2018.

sources.title: Vineyard Pietershof
sources.claim: Smaller estate; Chardonnay once named Best Belgian Wine.

sources.title: Brouwerij Cornelissen
sources.claim: Sixth-generation family brewery in Opitter (Bree); 200-year-old copper kettles.

sources.title: Cornelissen brewery profile
sources.claim: Renamed from Sint-Jozef in 2015; Ops-Ale, Limburgse Witte, Bokkereyer, Herkenrode.

sources.title: Achel Brewery
sources.claim: Lost Trappist status in 2021 when the last monks left.

sources.title: Achelse Kluis tours
sources.claim: Guided visits Saturdays/Sundays at 13:30 and 15:30.

sources.title: Michelin — Innesto
sources.claim: One Star — Koen Verjans, modern cuisine, open kitchen.

sources.title: Michelin — Cuchara
sources.claim: Two Stars (2026) — Jan Tournier, modern with Asian notes.

sources.title: Michelin — Ogst
sources.claim: One Star — Sébastien Wygaerts, modern French.

sources.title: Kempisch Vuur
sources.claim: Brewed by Brouwerij Pirlot in Zandhoven — not a Cornelissen beer.

sources.title: Elaisa — 2026 tariffs
sources.claim: Weekday €65 / weekend €69 day entry; daily 10:00-22:00.

sources.title: Elaisa Energetic Wellness
sources.claim: 11 saunas (Temazcal, Chakra, ceremonial); 8 baths incl. outdoor whirlpools.

sources.title: Carbon Sense City Spa
sources.claim: 700 m² spa on the 5th floor of Carbon Hotel Genk; weekend day-pass €19.

sources.title: Aquadroom arrangements
sources.claim: Hammam arrangement 2 pers €54.99 (regular €110); full-day access.

sources.title: Aquadroom — facilities
sources.claim: Sanarium, Löyly, Kelo, Turkish steam, Garra Rufa, rooftop pool, ice hut.

sources.title: Aquadroom pool — tariffs
sources.claim: Afternoon adults 6-54 €9.50 (€7 residents); 55+ €5.50.

sources.title: Kajak Maasland
sources.claim: Kayak / canoe rental on the Maas; 13 km route 2.5-5 h; ~€25 per person.

sources.title: Valkenburg distance
sources.claim: Thermae 2000 ~40-45 km from Slagmolen — outside the 30 km radius.
